_meta.source: data.gov.my fuel price weekly API (id=fuelprice) — updated daily via scripts/update_fuel_prices.py

fuel.note: Pump prices = what consumers pay: RON95 RM2.05 (SKPS-subsidized), diesel RM2.10 (BUDI); RON97 RM4.25 unsubsidized market. Raw market levels in market_rm_per_l. Price week: 2026-09-03.

co2_factors.note: Grid Emission Factors: Energy Commission Malaysia / Malaysia Energy Statistics (2026 publication of provisional 2022-2024 data), 2024 values — Peninsular 0.740, Sabah 0.539, Sarawak 0.199 kg CO2e/kWh. east_malaysia is a 60/40 Sarawak/Sabah generation-weighted blend of those two sourced values (0.6*0.199 + 0.4*0.539 = 0.335), kept because the profile schema only offers peninsular/east_malaysia; sabah and sarawak are carried separately so the region can be split without re-sourcing. Replaces the previous 0.63/0.33 estimates, which this file's own note flagged for replacement once a sourced figure existed.
